changes.summary: compileHarness compares the input and output validators an operation descriptor lists, and the mapping an entry contract lists, by installed name, so a catalog whose alias table renames only an operation's validators or only an entry's mapping compiles; the alias such a listed name relies on is recorded in provenance.aliases. installedReadAdapters requires each read validator the harness pins, found through its recorded aliases, to equal the first-party validator the read lists. Also rebuilt on workspace-system's optional workspace composition fields.
@schema mandate adds optional authority.words allow-list alongside authority.excluded-words; also rebuilt on workspace-system's optional workspace composition fields.

The @workspace and @mandate authoring references document composition.public-agent, composition.private-agent, composition.decides and authority.words, and are rebuilt on agent-system, workspace-system and agent-composition-system.
